messages:
sophia: Quick thread 1 - I'm updating the SOC2 audit-logs doc. Goals: tighten the default retention sentence, add a clear tenant-scoped example that shows a redaction flag, and include a short JS SDK migration note (old -> new API). Can folks eyeball?

 tom: Yep — what's the proposed retention phrasing?

 sophia: Draft: "By default, Redwood retains audit logs for 90 days. Extended retention may be available under enterprise contracts; Dedicated and Private deployments offer operator-configurable retention." Want to avoid absolute language.

 legal_arya: That looks good and cautious. Add: "Redwood segregates tenant audit data and does not make tenant logs available to other customers. Logs are encrypted at rest; Private deployments may be configured with customer-managed KMS. Retention and access controls are subject to contract terms."

 docs-checker-bot: lint: avoid phrases like "we never" or "always" in compliance docs. Flag: include redaction guidance and an operator-only appendix if you show curl.

 tom: Agreed. Also include a line that SDKs normalize to camelCase while wire JSON uses snake_case so people don't get tripped up.

 sophia: Good call. Draft tenant-scoped JSON example for the page (copyable):
```json
{
  "name": "model.invoke",
  "tenant_id": "tenant_abc",
  "data": { "prompt": "[REDACTED]" },
  "redacted_fields": ["prompt"],
  "timestamp": "2026-06-10T10:00:00Z"
}
```
This shows the redaction marker and the redacted_fields hint.

 ops-luca: That example is fine. If you include an HTTP/curl example, put it under an "Operator appendix" with a warning and do not promote the internal endpoint. Sample operator curl (appendix only):
```bash
# operator-only: internal endpoint
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.svc/v1/audit \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"model.invoke","tenant_id":"tenant_abc","data":{}}'
```
Add a short note that auth tokens and endpoint shape are implementation details for operators.

 tom: For the JS SDK migration snippet, we renamed the audit method and some field names. Proposed short migration block for the docs page:```js
// OLD
await client.audit.log({ event: 'model.invoke', tenantId: 'tenant_abc', payload });
// NEW
await client.audit.emit({ name: 'model.invoke', tenantId: 'tenant_abc', data: payload });
```
Add a one-liner: "Note: wire-level JSON uses snake_case (tenant_id); SDK normalizes fields to camelCase."

 legal_arya: +1. Also add recommended developer guidance: "Customers should redact PII from prompt text or configure shorter retention; Redwood will follow contractual retention instructions for enterprise customers."

 sophia: I'll add that. Also adding a tiny migration checklist: search repo for `.audit.log(` and replace with `.audit.emit(` and update key names.

 docs-checker-bot: lint: include link to migration PR if available and add `legal:review` label for any contractual wording.

 sophia: Opening WIP PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2654 (WIP). Tagging @legal_arya and @ops-luca for review.

 tom: Quick nit: include a one-line example showing `redacted_fields: ["prompt"]` in the SDK example too so it's easy to copy-paste.

 sophia: Done. Final draft looks good locally; will push changes and ping reviewers. Thanks! :tada:

 ops-luca: I'll scan the appendix once it's up. Make sure we don't leak internal endpoint examples into the main nav.

 legal_arya: I'll do a rapid legal pass once PR has the label.

 sophia: Will add `legal:review` and `ops:notify` labels before request review. I'll post back when merged.
